reference_sql:
SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(units) AS units,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(units) / SUM(SUM(units)) OVER (PARTITION BY category_name), 2) AS share_pct
FROM sales
WHERE parent_category = 'Audio'
  AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY category_name, product_id
alternatives:
WITH product_units AS (  -- one row per Audio product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE parent_category = 'Audio'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
category_units AS (  -- one row per Audio category with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, SUM(units) AS total_units
  FROM product_units
  GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT pu.category_name, pu.product_id, pu.units,
       ROUND(100.0 * pu.units / cu.total_units, 2) AS share_pct
FROM product_units pu
JOIN category_units cu ON cu.category_name = pu.category_name

  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
category_units AS (  -- one row per Audio category with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, SUM(units) AS total_units
  FROM product_units
  GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT pu.category_name, pu.product_id, pu.units,
       ROUND(100.0 * pu.units / cu.total_units, 2) AS share_pct
FROM product_units pu
JOIN category_units cu ON cu.category_name = pu.category_name
other_way.tradeoff: Category totals in their own step, joined back, give the same shares without a window, but take two steps and a join.
